title: MITM · single-pair AES key preimage

target.description: 4 full rounds of AES-128: find a complete key compatible with one predetermined plaintext/ciphertext pair, equivalently a one-block DM preimage. This is not an identification probability for the original long secret key.

setting.key_relation: The source-defined public key or public round keys.
setting.plaintext_model: One predetermined public plaintext/ciphertext pair; search over the AES message-key input.

time.note: Source SKP expected cost for one consistent preimage key, not the two-block OWF cost.

data.note: One fixed public pair; no chosen-plaintext codebook.

memory.note: Table1 and defining SCIS table/index description.

preprocessing.note: Setup is included in total work unless separately stated.

success.description: The checked analysis gives an expected-work or filtering argument without a numeric probability for the complete named output event.

review.scope: PDF p.7 Table1; pp.10–12 definitions; p.38 AppendixC.1/Figure14.

evidence.locator: PDF p.7 Table1; pp.10–12 definitions; p.38 AppendixC.1/Figure14.
evidence.interpretation: Defining primary-text costs, output event and conditions checked together.

limitations: The complete named output probability is not quantified by the source.

variables.name: h
variables.condition: Predetermined initial value; no IV search is allowed.

variables.name: m
variables.condition: One message whose full compression output equals the target.

variables.name: y
variables.condition: Predetermined target independent of the searched message.

experiment.distinctness: One preimage for the fixed target and IV; no IV freedom.
experiment.reference: Ideal 128-bit compression output, generic classical preimage work approximately 2^128.
